description: Saving minutes content: version check, sanitising and editor permission.

preconditions: Draft revision with content and UpdatedAt T.
Actor is the current Secretary who manages the meeting; the caller read the revision at T.
cases.inputs:
minutesId: the Draft revision; actor: the current Secretary; content: "

Biên bản họp quý 3.

"; loadedAt: T.
cases.return: Content stored as the filtered HTML; UpdatedAt moves to now; 200 MSG396.
cases.log: Saved: content and UpdatedAt on the Draft revision; realtime minutes-changed push to the meeting's readers.
cases.note: UC-60 · MSG396 · Deviation: success also emits a realtime minutes-changed push (working-tree change).

preconditions: Draft revision; actor is the current Secretary; the caller read it at T.
cases.inputs: minutesId: the Draft revision; content: 300001 characters with text; loadedAt: T.
cases.return: Failure Invalid; 400 MSG402; errors[content] holds the limit message for the 300000-character limit (formatted with N0 in the process culture); nothing saved.
cases.note: UC-60 · MSG402 · Deviation: the limit message formats the 300000 limit with N0 in the process culture, so the separator follows the server locale.
